source_bound_theorem.name: Boolean Schaefer dichotomy
source_bound_theorem.modern_reference: Jonsson, Lagerkvist, Osipov, CSPs with Few Alien Constraints, CP 2024, Theorem 2
source_bound_theorem.consequence: SAT({OR2,EVEN_XOR3}) is NP-complete because the finite language lies in none of the six tractable classes.

connected_implication: If every connected instance over this fixed mixed language had a polynomial exact solver/carrier, polynomial connected-component decomposition would solve arbitrary instances of this NP-complete language in polynomial time; therefore such an unrestricted mechanism would imply P=NP.

interpretation.positive: The remaining unrestricted connected composition problem is not justified as routine glue merely because each component language is separately tractable.
interpretation.required_for_next_progress: Add a preregistered structural restriction that prevents unrestricted Schaefer-hard mixed composition, or explicitly attack the P-vs-NP-scale barrier.
interpretation.not_a_lower_bound: This theorem does not prove that no polynomial mixed-carrier solver exists; that would resolve P versus NP.

scientific_firewall.FINITE_RUN_ROLE: The finite checker verifies exact relation classification and implementation. NP-completeness is imported only through the cited dichotomy theorem.
